description: This file defines the FreeTierClient class for interacting with the AWS Free Tier service, extending the base AwsClient class and including methods for retrieving free tier usage synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: FreeTierClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Free Tier services, extending the AwsClient base class.

methods.name: getFreeTierUsage
methods.description: Retrieves current free tier usage synchronously.

methods.name: getFreeTierUsageAsync
methods.description: Retrieves current free tier usage asynchronously, returning a Promise.
